notes.cpi: India CPI inflation, yearly average (rateinflation.com; 2013 approximate, 2026 year to date).
notes.crypto: Bitcoin in rupees; gains taxed at a flat 30% in India, losses can't be set off.
notes.epf: EPF rate declared for each financial year (EPFO); tax-free for most salaried people.
notes.fd: Typical 1-year bank FD rate for each financial year (approximate, Bajaj Finserv history / SBI), renewed every year; interest taxed every year at your slab.
notes.foreign: S&P 500 / NASDAQ 100: index price in rupees (USD/INR from Yahoo), dividends not included; taxed as foreign assets (12.5% after 24 months, slab before).
notes.ppf: PPF rate for each financial year (Ministry of Finance); tax-free; deposits capped at ₹1.5 lakh a year.
notes.reit: Indian REITs: unit price plus an assumed 6% a year of distributions reinvested (they pay out most of their rent; exact payouts vary).
